title: Is a $20,000 One‑Time Purchase Worth It?

scenes.text: Spending $20,000 on a single item sounds thrilling.
People often believe a big purchase equals instant happiness or status.
scenes.label: Big spend = happiness

scenes.text: Studies show after the first week, satisfaction returns to baseline, while the money could have earned ~7% annual return if invested.
scenes.label: Money works better invested
scenes.query: study happiness after big purchase baseline return

scenes.text: Ask yourself: could that $20,000 grow to $40,000 in a decade?
scenes.label: Invest, Don't Splurge

scenes.text: Follow for the wealth lessons school skipped.
scenes.query: follow for money habits call to action

description: A $20,000 splurge feels rewarding, but the long‑term impact is often negative. Discover why investing beats instant gratification. Follow for evidence‑based habits.
